title: Set up the feedback round-up and put it in HQ
ask: Daniel ruled Q-89 option a — itch comments are the channel and the page says nothing new — and set the process: the community manager reviews player feedback at regular intervals and brings it to him. While throughput is low it is enough to show him the feedback itself with links; statistics, escalation rules and deciding what to keep from him come later, when there is enough of it to be a drain.
first_action: Write down the review cadence and where feedback lands, then add the panel to HQ that shows the itch comments with a link to each.
